data.title: Crafting a Comprehensive Tutorial for Vectara Chat
data.body:
We're seeking talented individual to develop a comprehensive tutorial for Vectara Chat, a cutting-edge conversational AI platform. If you're passionate about AI and love sharing knowledge, this opportunity is for you!

### The Plan and Structure of the Tutorial (recommended)
Here's an outline of what we're looking for in the tutorial:
**Introduction to Vectara Chat**
**Getting Started with Vectara Chat**
**Building a Chatbot with Vectara**
**Enhancing Chatbot Intelligence**
**Deploying and Testing Chatbots**
**Conclusion / Tips for Hackathon participants on use cases for the models**

Focus on original, personalized content with descriptive details and code samples as needed. Feel free to use your personal author style, with wording "In this tutorial I will show you...", "this time I want to show you..." etc.
Refer to our [Tutorial Guidelines](https://github.com/lablab-ai/community-content/blob/main/tutorials/README.md) for requirements.

If you're interested in creating this tutorial, please submit a proposal outlining your approach, including a breakdown of the topics you plan to cover and any additional resources or support you may need. We're excited to work with passionate freelancers who share our vision for empowering developers with the tools and knowledge they need to succeed in the world of AI.

### Tutorials / Tech Pages To Link in the article (in the list we mention recommended keywords for links)
[Vectara Beginner App Tutorial](https://lablab.ai/t/vectara-beginner-app-tutorial-showcase-the-creation-of-vectara-app-in-legal-use-case)
[Vectara Advanced App Tutorial](https://lablab.ai/t/vectara-advanced-app-tutorial-showcase-the-creation-of-vectara-app-in-legal-or-customer-support-use-case)
### 🔑 Tech details and access
In case you would face any issues in terms of the usage of the model, or accessing the features you need for tutorial, or credits, please, contact katyatkach#9866 via Discord, or katya.tkach@newnative.ai via email.
### ✅ Checking and publishing process
Our SEO specialist and developer from the lablab.ai team will review the tutorial draft. We'll provide feedback on any changes needed before final approval.
### 🔗 Links
Pasting links, that are not for "lablab.ai/" inside of the text, follow anchor tag with the attribute:
[Link to Example.com](https://example.com/)
Bounty $60
Hard DEADLINE: April 8th, 2024
